story.title: The Glass Embassy
story.subtitle: A perfume launch masks an auction for the identity of a vanished double agent.
story.premise: Madame Sabine Vautrin's private unveiling of a Riviera perfume called Ambassade de Verre brings five accomplished strangers to a house in Grambois. Each accepted a different private promise from Sabine Vautrin; one came to make sure that promise could never be kept.

characters.name: Colette Renaud
characters.title: Perfume journalist
characters.costume: 1960s Riviera evening wear suited to perfume journalist
characters.publicFace: Incisive, amused, and always two questions ahead
characters.invitationPretext: You were invited to Madame Sabine Vautrin's private unveiling of a Riviera perfume called Ambassade de Verre in your public capacity as perfume journalist.
characters.invitationPromise: Sabine promised you the true story behind her most famous formula.
characters.privateIdentity: You once traded an embassy rumour for access and have spent years burying the source.
characters.privateObjective: Publish the truth without exposing the source you betrayed.
characters.privateSecret: You stole a page of Sabine’s formula notes because it contains your old source mark.

objectives.title: Collect the promise
objectives.text: Get another suspect to acknowledge what the host privately promised you: Sabine promised you the true story behind her most famous formula.

objectives.title: Gain useful leverage
objectives.text: Learn why Étienne Marot is concealing evidence and trade that knowledge for a clue, token, or public concession.

objectives.title: Shape the reckoning
objectives.text: Put your private objective before the table while keeping your own compromising secret from deciding the vote.

relationships.text: Étienne Marot can confirm part of your cover story, but only by exposing their own.
Lucien Arbaud once helped your career and now expects repayment.

secrets.text: Before the unveiling, you heard Lucien tell Étienne that Sabine had promised to name SABLE before midnight.

solutionSteps.title: The formula with two meanings
solutionSteps.truth: Sabine encoded the name of double agent SABLE in the perfume formula and promised five different people control of it.

solutionSteps.title: A toast that silenced the broker
solutionSteps.truth: Étienne Marot recognized that SABLE was his own handler identity and poisoned Sabine before she could name him.

openingSteps.title: Receive Colette Renaud
openingSteps.instruction: Invite Colette Renaud to deliver only the prepared opening fact. Colette Renaud: State that Sabine invited the press for a perfume story, then ask why diplomats were included.

openingSteps.title: Receive Étienne Marot
openingSteps.trigger: After Colette Renaud completes their cue
openingSteps.instruction: Invite Étienne Marot to deliver only the prepared opening fact. Étienne Marot: Correct Colette: announce that you came only to discuss export licences, not diplomacy.

openingSteps.title: Receive Nadia Petrov
openingSteps.trigger: After Étienne Marot completes their cue
openingSteps.instruction: Invite Nadia Petrov to deliver only the prepared opening fact. Nadia Petrov: Reveal that Sabine privately promised a reunion, but refuse to name with whom.

openingSteps.title: Receive Marc Delon
openingSteps.trigger: After Nadia Petrov completes their cue
openingSteps.instruction: Invite Marc Delon to deliver only the prepared opening fact. Marc Delon: Announce that the celebrated formula is incomplete and only Sabine knows the missing line.

openingSteps.title: Discover the host
openingSteps.trigger: After Marc Delon completes their cue
openingSteps.instruction: Cue Lucien Arbaud, stage Sabine Vautrin's off-page collapse without contact, announce the discovery, and become Game Master. Lucien Arbaud: Offer a toast to old secrets and say that one of Sabine’s formulas is really a confession.

host.name: Sabine Vautrin
host.title: Sabine Vautrin, perfumer and intelligence broker; then Game Master

story.solutionSummary: Étienne was SABLE. He altered Sabine’s drink during the perfume toast, then encouraged everyone to treat the coded formula as a commercial dispute. Sabine’s separate promises explain every suspect’s secrecy; the overlapping memories prove Étienne alone understood the code before her death.

clues.text: Sabine scheduled a private conversation with each guest under a different commercial pretext.
The initials in the disputed formula spell SABLE when read as intelligence call signs.
Étienne used the word “handler” before anyone publicly said the formula concerned espionage.
A cottage appointment places Étienne close enough to learn Sabine planned to reveal SABLE that night.
The fatal dose acted during the toast, not earlier in the evening.

acts.title: The fatal interruption
acts.operatorGoal: Establish Madame Sabine Vautrin's private unveiling of a Riviera perfume called Ambassade de Verre, stage the single no-contact death, then become Game Master.
acts.playerGoal: Deliver only your short prepared cue and wait for the body to be discovered before bargaining begins.

setupRequirements.label: Confirm that the entire opening is spoken and staged without contact.
